decision: Add unclear-input handling to the dispatch-first interruption slice

contract.start: Start only after meaningful interim STT commits TurnChange
contract.extend: Extend on additional meaningful interim STT
contract.stop: Stop on usable non-empty final STT or completed user input
contract.ignore: Do not start for VAD-only, empty interim or filler-only overlap
contract.expire: Inject the configured unclear-input message without resuming old assistant output
